ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.description: An overview of all {{total}} available AI models. For each model, you can see its capabilities, intended use, and how it compares to other models. This helps you choose the right model per task, use case, or workflow in a transparent and consistent way.
ai.providers: An overview of all {{total}} available AI providers. For each provider, you can see what it offers, how it fits into different use cases, and when it makes sense to use it. This helps you select the right provider per task or workflow in a clear and consistent way.

model_provider.label: Model Builder
model_provider.description: Builds and owns foundation AI models that can be used directly or via other platforms.

gateway_router.label: Gateway
gateway_router.description: Routes requests across multiple AI providers, often with unified APIs, fallback, and billing.

inference_compute.label: Compute
inference_compute.description: Provides infrastructure and runtime capacity for hosting and running AI inference workloads.

media_voice.label: Media
media_voice.description: Focuses on image, video, speech, audio, voice, and other creative-generation APIs.

search_data.label: Search
search_data.description: Provides search, retrieval, embeddings, reranking, OCR, and data-intelligence capabilities.

app_tools.label: Apps/tools
app_tools.description: Delivers agent tools, AI apps, workflow utilities, and specialized application capabilities.

webAppsPage.description: Apps are practical applications that emerge from AI interaction. They turn questions, instructions, and data into something tangible, such as an overview, dashboard, or tool. Apps can be reused and shared, while AI continues to adapt and improve them based on new input.

catalogsPage.description: Catalogs contain definitions of components and actions that AI uses to assemble apps. They describe which components and actions are available and how they can be used. Catalogs form the foundation for building apps.

registriesPage.description: Registries contain component implementations used to run apps. This makes it possible to run a single app using multiple implementations.

filesPage.description: An overview of all locally available files. Drag and drop files onto this page to add them and allow AI to read and create files through tools.

mcpPage.title: Model Context
mcpPage.description: Model Context Protocol gives you one structured way to work with prompts, resources and tools, no matter where the information comes from. You always work clearly, transparently and in the same way.
